```{r candidates_data, echo=FALSE}
# Quartile break points and range labels (mirrors .q_range_labels in fig_opportunity)
.cq_base   <- c("Q1 (lowest)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4 (highest)")
.cq_brks_dm    <- quantile(dm_scored$qrisk10y,  c(0, .25, .5, .75, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
.cq_brks_ascvd <- quantile(ascvd_scored$react5y, c(0, .25, .5, .75, 1), na.rm = TRUE)

.mk_cq_lbls <- function(brks, base = .cq_base) setNames(c(
  sprintf("%s\n(<%.1f%%)",     base[1], brks[2]),
  sprintf("%s\n(%.1f–%.1f%%)", base[2], brks[2], brks[3]),
  sprintf("%s\n(%.1f–%.1f%%)", base[3], brks[3], brks[4]),
  sprintf("%s\n(>%.1f%%)",     base[4], brks[4])
), base)

cq_labs_dm    <- .mk_cq_lbls(.cq_brks_dm)
cq_labs_ascvd <- .mk_cq_lbls(.cq_brks_ascvd)

# Flag each patient by LDL and SBP treatment status
dm_cand <- dm_scored |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(qrisk10y), !is.na(ldl), !is.na(sbp)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    risk_q     = cut(qrisk10y, breaks = .cq_brks_dm,
                     labels = .cq_base, include.lowest = TRUE),
    risk_q_lbl = factor(cq_labs_dm[as.character(risk_q)],
                        levels = unname(cq_labs_dm)),
    risk5y = 1 - (1 - qrisk10y / 100)^0.5,
    ldl_status = dplyr::case_when(
      llt_int == 0     & ldl <= ldl_target_dm ~ "NC: No LLT, at target",
      llt_int %in% 1:2 & ldl <= ldl_target_dm ~ "NC: LI LLT, at target",
      llt_int >= 3     & ldl <= ldl_target_dm ~ "NC: HI LLT, at target",
      llt_int == 0     & ldl >  ldl_target_dm ~ "C: No LLT, not at target",
      llt_int %in% 1:2 & ldl >  ldl_target_dm ~ "C: LI LLT, not at target",
      llt_int >= 3     & ldl >  ldl_target_dm ~ "NC: HI LLT, not at target"
    ),
    sbp_status = dplyr::case_when(
      sbp <= sbp_target                    ~ "NC: At target",
      aht_int %in% 1:3 & sbp > sbp_target ~ "C: 1-3 agents, above target",
      aht_int == 4     & sbp > sbp_target ~ "NC: 4 agents, above target",
      aht_int == 0     & sbp > sbp_target ~ "C: No AHT, above target"
    ),
    ldl_cand = ldl > ldl_target_dm    & llt_int < 3,
    sbp_cand = sbp > sbp_target       & aht_int < 4,
    any_cand = ldl_cand | sbp_cand
  )

ascvd_cand <- ascvd_scored |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(react5y), !is.na(ldl), !is.na(sbp)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    risk_q     = cut(react5y, breaks = .cq_brks_ascvd,
                     labels = .cq_base, include.lowest = TRUE),
    risk_q_lbl = factor(cq_labs_ascvd[as.character(risk_q)],
                        levels = unname(cq_labs_ascvd)),
    risk5y = react5y / 100,
    ldl_status = dplyr::case_when(
      llt_int == 0     & ldl <= ldl_target_ascvd ~ "NC: No LLT, at target",
      llt_int %in% 1:2 & ldl <= ldl_target_ascvd ~ "NC: LI LLT, at target",
      llt_int >= 3     & ldl <= ldl_target_ascvd ~ "NC: HI LLT, at target",
      llt_int == 0     & ldl >  ldl_target_ascvd ~ "C: No LLT, not at target",
      llt_int %in% 1:2 & ldl >  ldl_target_ascvd ~ "C: LI LLT, not at target",
      llt_int >= 3     & ldl >  ldl_target_ascvd ~ "NC: HI LLT, not at target"
    ),
    sbp_status = dplyr::case_when(
      sbp <= sbp_target                    ~ "NC: At target",
      aht_int %in% 1:3 & sbp > sbp_target ~ "C: 1-3 agents, above target",
      aht_int == 4     & sbp > sbp_target ~ "NC: 4 agents, above target",
      aht_int == 0     & sbp > sbp_target ~ "C: No AHT, above target"
    ),
    ldl_cand = ldl > ldl_target_ascvd & llt_int < 3,
    sbp_cand = sbp > sbp_target       & aht_int < 4,
    any_cand = ldl_cand | sbp_cand
  )

# RR bounds - same values as fig_opportunity
.rr_cand <- list(
  DM    = list(central = c(sbp=0.90, ldl=0.79),
               pessim  = c(sbp=0.95, ldl=0.86),
               optimis = c(sbp=0.84, ldl=0.72)),
  ASCVD = list(central = c(sbp=0.80, ldl=0.78),
               pessim  = c(sbp=0.83, ldl=0.80),
               optimis = c(sbp=0.77, ldl=0.76))
)

# Events prevented per 1,000 candidates using patient-specific deltas to reach target
.cand_ep <- function(df, cohort, rr) {
  ldl_tgt <- if (cohort == "DM") ldl_target_dm else ldl_target_ascvd
  df |>
    dplyr::filter(any_cand, !is.na(risk_q)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      d_ldl = dplyr::if_else(ldl_cand, pmax(ldl - ldl_tgt, 0), 0),
      d_sbp = dplyr::if_else(sbp_cand, pmax(sbp - 130, 0), 0),
      hr    = rr["sbp"]^(d_sbp / 10) * rr["ldl"]^d_ldl,
      ep    = risk5y * (1 - hr)
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(risk_q, risk_q_lbl) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_cand   = dplyr::n(),
      ep_per1k = mean(ep, na.rm = TRUE) * 1000,
      .groups  = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Cohort = if (cohort == "DM") "DM (primary)" else "ASCVD (secondary)")
}

# Compute all bounds and pivot to wide for error bars
cand_ep_wide <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  .cand_ep(dm_cand,    "DM",    .rr_cand$DM$central)    |> dplyr::mutate(bound = "central"),
  .cand_ep(dm_cand,    "DM",    .rr_cand$DM$pessim)     |> dplyr::mutate(bound = "pessim"),
  .cand_ep(dm_cand,    "DM",    .rr_cand$DM$optimis)    |> dplyr::mutate(bound = "optimis"),
  .cand_ep(ascvd_cand, "ASCVD", .rr_cand$ASCVD$central) |> dplyr::mutate(bound = "central"),
  .cand_ep(ascvd_cand, "ASCVD", .rr_cand$ASCVD$pessim)  |> dplyr::mutate(bound = "pessim"),
  .cand_ep(ascvd_cand, "ASCVD", .rr_cand$ASCVD$optimis) |> dplyr::mutate(bound = "optimis")
) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(risk_q, risk_q_lbl, Cohort, n_cand),
    names_from  = bound,
    values_from = ep_per1k
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(ep_per1k = central, err_lo = pessim, err_hi = optimis)

cand_ep_dm    <- dplyr::filter(cand_ep_wide, Cohort == "DM (primary)")
cand_ep_ascvd <- dplyr::filter(cand_ep_wide, Cohort == "ASCVD (secondary)")

# Scenario 1: only treatment-naïve candidates (llt_int == 0 / aht_int == 0) are
# initiated on high-intensity statin (~1.0 mmol/L LDL reduction) and standard
# first-line antihypertensive (~10 mmHg SBP reduction), capped at patient gap.
# Undertreated patients contribute zero delta in this scenario.
.cand_ep_initiated <- function(df, cohort, rr,
                                d_ldl_init = 1.0, d_sbp_init = 10) {
  ldl_tgt <- if (cohort == "DM") ldl_target_dm else ldl_target_ascvd
  df |>
    dplyr::filter(any_cand, !is.na(risk_q)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      d_ldl = dplyr::if_else(ldl_cand & llt_int == 0,
                             pmin(pmax(ldl - ldl_tgt, 0), d_ldl_init), 0),
      d_sbp = dplyr::if_else(sbp_cand & aht_int == 0,
                             pmin(pmax(sbp - 130,    0), d_sbp_init), 0),
      hr    = rr["sbp"]^(d_sbp / 10) * rr["ldl"]^d_ldl,
      ep    = risk5y * (1 - hr)
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(risk_q, risk_q_lbl) |>
    dplyr::summarise(ep_per1k = mean(ep, na.rm = TRUE) * 1000, .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Cohort = if (cohort == "DM") "DM (primary)" else "ASCVD (secondary)")
}

cand_scen <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  .cand_ep_initiated(dm_cand,    "DM",    .rr_cand$DM$central)    |>
    dplyr::mutate(Scenario = "All candidates treated"),
  .cand_ep_initiated(ascvd_cand, "ASCVD", .rr_cand$ASCVD$central) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Scenario = "All candidates treated"),
  cand_ep_wide |>
    dplyr::select(risk_q, risk_q_lbl, Cohort, ep_per1k) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Scenario = "Candidates reach target")
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Scenario = factor(Scenario,
    levels = c("All candidates treated", "Candidates reach target")))

cand_scen_pal <- c(
  "All candidates treated" = "#bddd1d",
  "Candidates reach target"    = "#34aa6f"
)

cand_scen_dm    <- dplyr::filter(cand_scen, Cohort == "DM (primary)")
cand_scen_ascvd <- dplyr::filter(cand_scen, Cohort == "ASCVD (secondary)")

# Stacked bar data for E/F: bottom = "All candidates treated", top = marginal
# Mirrors figure 3 C/D stacking logic
cand_stacked <- cand_scen |>
  dplyr::select(risk_q, risk_q_lbl, Cohort, ep_per1k, Scenario) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Scenario, values_from = ep_per1k) |>
  dplyr::mutate(marginal_ep = `Candidates reach target` - `All candidates treated`) |>
  dplyr::select(-`Candidates reach target`) |>
  dplyr::rename(initiated_ep = `All candidates treated`) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(initiated_ep, marginal_ep),
                      names_to = "component", values_to = "ep_per1k") |>
  dplyr::mutate(component = factor(component,
    levels = c("marginal_ep", "initiated_ep"),
    labels = c("Additional to target", "All candidates treated")))

cand_stacked_dm    <- dplyr::filter(cand_stacked, Cohort == "DM (primary)")
cand_stacked_ascvd <- dplyr::filter(cand_stacked, Cohort == "ASCVD (secondary)")

cand_bar_pal <- c(
  "All candidates treated" = "#bddd1d",
  "Additional to target"   = "#56026a"
)

# CI bounds for "All candidates treated" (treatment-naive initiated only)
cand_init_wide <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  .cand_ep_initiated(dm_cand,    "DM",    .rr_cand$DM$pessim)    |> dplyr::mutate(bound = "pessim"),
  .cand_ep_initiated(dm_cand,    "DM",    .rr_cand$DM$optimis)   |> dplyr::mutate(bound = "optimis"),
  .cand_ep_initiated(ascvd_cand, "ASCVD", .rr_cand$ASCVD$pessim) |> dplyr::mutate(bound = "pessim"),
  .cand_ep_initiated(ascvd_cand, "ASCVD", .rr_cand$ASCVD$optimis)|> dplyr::mutate(bound = "optimis")
) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = c(risk_q, risk_q_lbl, Cohort),
                     names_from = bound, values_from = ep_per1k) |>
  dplyr::rename(err_lo = pessim, err_hi = optimis)
cand_init_dm    <- dplyr::filter(cand_init_wide, Cohort == "DM (primary)")
cand_init_ascvd <- dplyr::filter(cand_init_wide, Cohort == "ASCVD (secondary)")

# Inline scalars
.p2 <- function(x) round(100 * mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 1)

pct_any_cand_dm       <- .p2(dm_cand$any_cand)
pct_ldl_cand_dm       <- .p2(dm_cand$ldl_cand)

pct_any_cand_ascvd    <- .p2(ascvd_cand$any_cand)
pct_ldl_cand_ascvd    <- .p2(ascvd_cand$ldl_cand)
pct_sbp_cand_ascvd    <- .p2(ascvd_cand$sbp_cand)

ep_cand_dm_q4    <- round(cand_ep_dm$ep_per1k[cand_ep_dm$risk_q == "Q4 (highest)"], 1)

ep_cand_ascvd_q4 <- round(cand_ep_ascvd$ep_per1k[cand_ep_ascvd$risk_q == "Q4 (highest)"], 1)
```

```{r fig_candidates, fig.width=8, fig.asp=1, echo=FALSE}
ldl_pal    <- c("NC: No LLT, at target"     = "#a8d5b8",
                "NC: LI LLT, at target"     = "#d5edcf",
                "NC: HI LLT, at target"     = "#b8d8eb",
                "NC: HI LLT, not at target" = "#8fafc8",
                "C: LI LLT, not at target"     = "#fdae61",
                "C: No LLT, not at target"     = "#d73027")
ldl_levels <- c("NC: HI LLT, at target","NC: HI LLT, not at target",
                "NC: No LLT, at target","NC: LI LLT, at target",
                "C: LI LLT, not at target","C: No LLT, not at target")

sbp_pal    <- c("NC: At target"               = "#a8d5b8",
                "C: 1-3 agents, above target"    = "#fdae61",
                "NC: 4 agents, above target"  = "#8fafc8",
                "C: No AHT, above target"        = "#d73027")
sbp_levels <- c("NC: 4 agents, above target","NC: At target",
                "C: 1-3 agents, above target","C: No AHT, above target")
.cq_col4    <- c("#2171B5", "#6BAED6", "#F16913", "#CB181D")

# Build a named colour palette from a labelled quartile vector
.cq_pal_named <- function(q_lbls) setNames(.cq_col4, unname(q_lbls))

.ldl_status_q <- function(df, cohort_nm) {
  df |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(risk_q_lbl), !is.na(ldl_status)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(ldl_status = factor(ldl_status, levels = ldl_levels)) |>
    dplyr::count(risk_q_lbl, ldl_status, .drop = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::group_by(risk_q_lbl) |>
    dplyr::mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::mutate(Cohort = cohort_nm)
}

ldl_status_dm    <- .ldl_status_q(dm_cand,    "DM (primary)")
ldl_status_ascvd <- .ldl_status_q(ascvd_cand, "ASCVD (secondary)")

.sbp_status_q <- function(df, cohort_nm) {
  df |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(risk_q_lbl), !is.na(sbp_status)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(sbp_status = factor(sbp_status, levels = sbp_levels)) |>
    dplyr::count(risk_q_lbl, sbp_status, .drop = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::group_by(risk_q_lbl) |>
    dplyr::mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::mutate(Cohort = cohort_nm)
}

sbp_status_dm    <- .sbp_status_q(dm_cand,    "DM (primary)")
sbp_status_ascvd <- .sbp_status_q(ascvd_cand, "ASCVD (secondary)")

.ldl_bar <- function(d, q_lbls, tag, title_nm, show_legend = FALSE) {
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = risk_q_lbl, y = pct, fill = ldl_status)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = ldl_pal, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = unname(q_lbls)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 101), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    labs(tag = tag, title = title_nm, x = NULL, y = "Proportion (%)") +
    theme_cap() +
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.5))
  if (!show_legend) p + theme(legend.position = "none") else p
}

.sbp_bar <- function(d, q_lbls, tag, title_nm, show_legend = FALSE) {
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = risk_q_lbl, y = pct, fill = sbp_status)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = sbp_pal, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = unname(q_lbls)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 101), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    labs(tag = tag, title = title_nm, x = NULL, y = "Proportion (%)") +
    theme_cap() +
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.5))
  if (!show_legend) p + theme(legend.position = "none") else p
}

pC_A <- .ldl_bar(ldl_status_dm,    cq_labs_dm,    "A", "DM (primary)")
pC_B <- .ldl_bar(ldl_status_ascvd, cq_labs_ascvd, "B", "ASCVD (secondary)", show_legend = TRUE) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), legend.position = "right") +
  labs(fill = 'LDL-C')
pC_C <- .sbp_bar(sbp_status_dm,    cq_labs_dm,    "C", NULL)
pC_D <- .sbp_bar(sbp_status_ascvd, cq_labs_ascvd, "D", NULL, show_legend = TRUE) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), legend.position = "right") +
  labs(fill = 'Blood pressure')

# Events prevented per 1,000 candidates: stacked bars + error bars matching fig3 C/D
# Bottom = "All candidates treated" (untreated initiated), top = marginal to target
# Error bars span 95% CI of total "Candidates reach target" estimate
.ep_bar <- function(stacked_df, ep_df, q_lbls, tag, show_y = TRUE, init_df = NULL) {
  ymax <- ceiling(max(ep_df$err_hi, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15)

  d <- stacked_df |>
    dplyr::mutate(risk_q_lbl = factor(risk_q_lbl, levels = unname(q_lbls)))
  d_err <- ep_df |>
    dplyr::mutate(risk_q_lbl = factor(risk_q_lbl, levels = unname(q_lbls)))

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = risk_q_lbl, y = ep_per1k, fill = component)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    geom_errorbar(data = d_err,
                  aes(x = risk_q_lbl, ymin = err_lo, ymax = err_hi),
                  inherit.aes = FALSE,
                  width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.6, colour = "#e66914") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cand_bar_pal, name = "Scenario") +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = unname(q_lbls)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, ymax), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    labs(tag = tag,
         x = "Baseline risk quartile",
         y = "Events prevented (per 1,000)") +
    theme_cap() +
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.5))

  if (!is.null(init_df)) {
    d_init <- init_df |>
      dplyr::mutate(risk_q_lbl = factor(risk_q_lbl, levels = unname(q_lbls)))
    p <- p + geom_errorbar(data = d_init,
                           aes(x = risk_q_lbl, ymin = err_lo, ymax = err_hi),
                           inherit.aes = FALSE,
                           width = 0.18, linewidth = 0.6, colour = "#e66914")
  }

  if (!show_y) p + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
  else p + theme(legend.position = "right",
                 legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
                 legend.key.height = unit(2, "lines"))
}

pC_E <- .ep_bar(cand_stacked_dm,    cand_ep_dm,    cq_labs_dm,    "E", show_y = TRUE)  + theme(legend.position = "none")
pC_F <- .ep_bar(cand_stacked_ascvd, cand_ep_ascvd, cq_labs_ascvd, "F", show_y = FALSE) + theme(legend.position = "right")

fig3 <- (pC_A | pC_B) / (pC_C | pC_D) / (pC_E | pC_F) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1))
fig3
ggsave("figures/fig3.tiff", fig3, width = 11, height = 11 * 1.1, dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
```

```{r fig_interact, include=FALSE}
# ── Heatmap panel function ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
.heat_panel <- function(dat, cohort_nm, metric_col, fill_label, tag,
                        limits, show_legend = FALSE) {
  d <- dat |>
    dplyr::filter(Cohort == cohort_nm, !is.na(risk_q)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(risk_q = factor(as.character(risk_q), levels = rev(q_labs_ix)))
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = wimd_f, y = risk_q, fill = .data[[metric_col]])) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%%", .data[[metric_col]])),
              size = 2.8, colour = "white", fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#CB181D", high = "#2171B5",
                        limits = limits, name = fill_label,
                        labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
    labs(tag = tag, title = NULL,
         x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_cap() +
    theme(plot.tag    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8))
  if (show_legend) p + theme(legend.position = "right")
  else             p + theme(legend.position = "none")
}
```

```{r suppl_table1, echo=FALSE}
# Classify candidates as untreated vs undertreated
# Untreated: at least one contributing condition has intensity 0
# Undertreated: all contributing conditions have intensity 1-3
dm_cand_tbl <- dm_cand |>
  dplyr::filter(any_cand) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    tx_status = dplyr::if_else(
      (ldl_cand & llt_int == 0) | (sbp_cand & aht_int == 0),
      "Untreated", "Undertreated"
    )
  )

ascvd_cand_tbl <- ascvd_cand |>
  dplyr::filter(any_cand) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    tx_status = dplyr::if_else(
      (ldl_cand & llt_int == 0) | (sbp_cand & aht_int == 0),
      "Untreated", "Undertreated"
    )
  )

pct  <- function(x) sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(x, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
mn   <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)",  mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
mn2  <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))

summ_cand <- function(df, is_dm = TRUE) {
  vt <- function(val) if (is_dm) "-" else pct(df$vascular_territory == val)
  list(
    "N"                               = nrow(df),
    "Age"                             = mn(df$age),
    "Male"                            = pct(df$sex == "M"),
    "Statin in last 6m"               = pct(df$statin_rx_last6m),
    "Systolic blood pressure"         = mn(df$sbp),
    "LDL-C"                           = mn2(df$ldl),
    "Body Mass Index"                 = mn(df$bmi),
    "WIMD quintile 1 (most deprived)" = pct(df$wimd == 1L),
    "Hypertension (treated)"          = pct(df$treated_htn),
    "Atrial fibrillation"             = pct(df$af),
    "CKD stage 3–5"                   = pct(df$ckd),
    "Heart failure"                   = pct(df$hf),
    "IHD"                             = vt("IHD"),
    "Stroke"                          = vt("Stroke"),
    "PAD"                             = vt("PAD"),
    "LDL candidate"                   = pct(df$ldl_cand),
    "SBP candidate"                   = pct(df$sbp_cand)
  )
}

all_cand_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(dm_cand_tbl, ascvd_cand_tbl)

ov_u  <- summ_cand(dplyr::filter(all_cand_tbl,  tx_status == "Untreated"),    is_dm = FALSE)
ov_ut <- summ_cand(dplyr::filter(all_cand_tbl,  tx_status == "Undertreated"), is_dm = FALSE)
dm_u  <- summ_cand(dplyr::filter(dm_cand_tbl,   tx_status == "Untreated"),    is_dm = TRUE)
dm_ut <- summ_cand(dplyr::filter(dm_cand_tbl,   tx_status == "Undertreated"), is_dm = TRUE)
ax_u  <- summ_cand(dplyr::filter(ascvd_cand_tbl, tx_status == "Untreated"),   is_dm = FALSE)
ax_ut <- summ_cand(dplyr::filter(ascvd_cand_tbl, tx_status == "Undertreated"), is_dm = FALSE)

cand_tbl <- data.frame(
  Characteristic  = names(ov_u),
  OV_Untreated    = unlist(ov_u),
  OV_Undertreated = unlist(ov_ut),
  DM_Untreated    = unlist(dm_u),
  DM_Undertreated = unlist(dm_ut),
  AX_Untreated    = unlist(ax_u),
  AX_Undertreated = unlist(ax_ut),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL
)

kbl(cand_tbl, align = c("l","c","c","c","c","c","c"),
    col.names = c("Characteristic",
                  "Untreated", "Undertreated",
                  "Untreated", "Undertreated",
                  "Untreated", "Undertreated")) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE, position = "left"
  ) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1,
                     "Overall" = 2,
                     "DM (primary)" = 2,
                     "ASCVD (secondary)" = 2)) |>
  column_spec(1, width = "16em") |>
  column_spec(2:7, width = "7em")
```

```{r suppl_table3, echo=FALSE}
rq_lvls <- c("Q1 (lowest)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4 (highest)")
rq_hdrs <- c("Q1 (lowest)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4 (highest)")

ax_rq <- lapply(rq_lvls, function(q)
  summ_cand(dplyr::filter(ascvd_cand_tbl, risk_q == q), is_dm = FALSE))
dm_rq <- lapply(rq_lvls, function(q)
  summ_cand(dplyr::filter(dm_cand_tbl,   risk_q == q), is_dm = TRUE))

rq_tbl <- data.frame(
  Characteristic = names(ax_rq[[1]]),
  setNames(lapply(ax_rq, unlist), paste0("AX_", rq_lvls)),
  setNames(lapply(dm_rq,  unlist), paste0("DM_", rq_lvls)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL
)

kbl(rq_tbl,
    align  = c("l", rep("c", 8)),
    col.names = c("Characteristic", rq_hdrs, rq_hdrs)) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE, position = "left"
  ) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1,
                     "ASCVD (secondary)" = 4,
                     "DM (primary)"      = 4)) |>
  column_spec(1, width = "15em") |>
  column_spec(2:9, width = "7em")
```

```{r fig_wimd, include=FALSE}
wimd_labels <- c("1 (most\ndeprived)", "2", "3", "4", "5 (least\ndeprived)")
wimd_pal    <- setNames(
  c("#D62728", "#FF7F0E", "#9467BD", "#17BECF", "#2CA02C"),
  wimd_labels
)

dm_wimd    <- dm_scored    |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(wimd), wimd %in% 1:5) |>
  dplyr::mutate(wimd_f = factor(wimd, levels = 1:5, labels = wimd_labels))
ascvd_wimd <- ascvd_scored |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(wimd), wimd %in% 1:5) |>
  dplyr::mutate(wimd_f = factor(wimd, levels = 1:5, labels = wimd_labels))

# ── Summary statistics by WIMD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
wimd_sum <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dm_wimd |>
    dplyr::group_by(wimd_f) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      pct_ldl_target = 100 * mean(ldl <= 2.0,             na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_sbp_target = 100 * mean(sbp <= 130,             na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_on_statin  = 100 * mean(statin_rx_last6m == 1L, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_on_aht     = 100 * mean(treated_htn == 1L,      na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Cohort = "DM (primary)"),
  ascvd_wimd |>
    dplyr::group_by(wimd_f) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      pct_ldl_target = 100 * mean(ldl <= 1.8,             na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_sbp_target = 100 * mean(sbp <= 130,             na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_on_statin  = 100 * mean(statin_rx_last6m == 1L, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_on_aht     = 100 * mean(treated_htn == 1L,      na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Cohort = "ASCVD (secondary)")
)

# ── Panel A: QRISK2 by WIMD (DM) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
pWA <- ggplot(dm_wimd |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(qrisk10y)),
              aes(x = qrisk10y, colour = wimd_f, fill = wimd_f)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.18, linewidth = 0.65) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = wimd_pal, name = "WIMD quintile") +
  scale_fill_manual(  values = wimd_pal, name = "WIMD quintile") +
  labs(tag = "A", title= "DM (primary)",
       x = "10-year risk (%)", y = "Density") +
  theme_cap() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13))

# ── Panel B: REACT by WIMD (ASCVD) ────────────────────────────────────────────
pWB <- ggplot(ascvd_wimd |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(react5y)),
              aes(x = react5y, colour = wimd_f, fill = wimd_f)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.18, linewidth = 0.65) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = wimd_pal, name = "WIMD quintile") +
  scale_fill_manual(  values = wimd_pal, name = "WIMD quintile") +
  labs(tag = "B", title = "ASCVD (secondary)",
       x = "5-year risk (%)", y = "Density") +
  theme_cap() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), legend.position = "right", plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13))

# ── Panels C/D: all 4 metrics by WIMD, split by cohort ────────────────────────
wimd_all_long <- wimd_sum |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols     = c(pct_ldl_target, pct_on_statin, pct_sbp_target, pct_on_aht),
    names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Pct"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Metric = factor(Metric,
                    levels = c("pct_ldl_target", "pct_on_statin",
                               "pct_sbp_target", "pct_on_aht"),
                    labels = c("At LDL target", "On LLT",
                               "At SBP target", "On AHT"))
  )

.metric_lbl_ldl <- "At LDL target\n(<2.0 / <1.8 mmol/L)"
.metric_lbl_sbp <- "At SBP target\n(≤130 mmHg)"
.metric_pal <- c(setNames("#CB181D", .metric_lbl_ldl), "On LLT" = "#FC9272",
                 setNames("#2171B5", .metric_lbl_sbp), "On AHT" = "#9ECAE1")
.metric_shp <- c(setNames(16, .metric_lbl_ldl), "On LLT" = 17,
                 setNames(15, .metric_lbl_sbp), "On AHT" = 18)
.metric_lvls <- c(.metric_lbl_ldl, "On LLT", .metric_lbl_sbp, "On AHT")

.recode_metric <- function(dat) {
  dat |> dplyr::mutate(
    Metric = factor(
      dplyr::recode(as.character(Metric),
                    "At LDL target" = .metric_lbl_ldl,
                    "At SBP target" = .metric_lbl_sbp),
      levels = .metric_lvls
    )
  )
}

.make_wimd_all <- function(dat, tag, show_legend = FALSE) {
  dat <- .recode_metric(dat)
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = wimd_f, y = Pct,
                       colour = Metric, group = Metric, shape = Metric)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.0) +
    geom_point(size = 3.2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = .metric_pal, name = "Metric") +
    scale_shape_manual(values  = .metric_shp, name = "Metric") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1),
                       limits = c(0, 100),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.14))) +
    labs(tag = tag, x = "WIMD quintile", y = "Proportion") +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 4), shape = guide_legend(nrow = 4)) +
    theme_cap() +
    theme(legend.text       = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.key.width  = unit(1.8, "lines"),
          legend.key.height = unit(2.2, "lines"),
          plot.tag          = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13))
  if (show_legend) p + theme(legend.position = "right")
  else             p + theme(legend.position = "none")
}

pWC <- .make_wimd_all(
  wimd_all_long |> dplyr::filter(Cohort == "DM (primary)"),   "C"
)
pWD <- .make_wimd_all(
  wimd_all_long |> dplyr::filter(Cohort == "ASCVD (secondary)"), "D", show_legend = TRUE
) + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())

fig5 <- (pWA | pWB) / (pWC | pWD) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1.2, 1))
fig5
ggsave("figures/fig5.tiff", fig5, width = 11, height = 11 * 0.75, dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
```

```{r fig_riskq, include=FALSE}
q_pal <- c("#2171B5", "#6BAED6", "#F16913", "#CB181D")

q_dm_breaks    <- quantile(dm_scored$qrisk10y,  probs = c(0, .25, .5, .75, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
q_ascvd_breaks <- quantile(ascvd_scored$react5y, probs = c(0, .25, .5, .75, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
q_labs         <- c("Q1 (lowest)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4 (highest)")
q_labs_dm      <- .q_range_labels(q_dm_breaks)
q_labs_ascvd   <- .q_range_labels(q_ascvd_breaks)

dm_q    <- dm_scored |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(qrisk10y)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(risk_q = cut(qrisk10y,  breaks = q_dm_breaks,
                              labels = q_labs_dm, include.lowest = TRUE))
ascvd_q <- ascvd_scored |>

# ── Quartile-level summaries ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

      pct_ldl_target = 100 * mean(ldl <= 2.0,             na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_sbp_target = 100 * mean(sbp <= 130,             na.rm = TRUE),

# ── Panel A: LDL-C by risk quartile (DM) ──────────────────────────────────────

  ) |>

.make_rq_panel <- function(dat, tag, subtitle, show_legend = FALSE) {
  dat <- dat |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(risk_q)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(risk_q = droplevels(risk_q)) |>
    .recode_metric()
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = risk_q, y = Pct,
               colour = Metric, group = Metric, shape = Metric)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.0) +
    geom_point(size = 3.0) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = .metric_pal, name = "Metric") +
    scale_shape_manual(values  = .metric_shp, name = "Metric") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1),
                       limits = c(0, 100),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.12))) +
    labs(tag = tag,
         x = "Baseline risk quartile", y = "Proportion") +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 4), shape = guide_legend(nrow = 4)) +
    theme_cap() +
    theme(legend.text       = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.key.width  = unit(2, "lines"),
          legend.key.height = unit(2.2, "lines"),
          plot.tag          = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13))
  if (show_legend) p + theme(legend.position = "right")
  else             p + theme(legend.position = "none")
}

pQE <- .make_rq_panel(
  rq_long |> dplyr::filter(Cohort == "DM (primary)"),
  "E", "DM (primary)"
)
pQF <- .make_rq_panel(
  rq_long |> dplyr::filter(Cohort == "ASCVD (secondary)"),
  "F", "ASCVD (secondary)", show_legend = TRUE
) + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())
```

```{r fig_sex, include=FALSE}
        plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13))

# ── Panels E/F: treatment metrics by sex (dodged bars) ────────────────────
sex_long <- sex_sum |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols     = c(pct_ldl_target, pct_on_statin, pct_sbp_target, pct_on_aht),
    names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Pct"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Metric = factor(Metric,
                    levels = c("pct_ldl_target", "pct_on_statin",
                               "pct_sbp_target", "pct_on_aht"),
                    labels = c("At LDL target", "On LLT",
                               "At SBP target", "On AHT"))
  ) |>
  .recode_metric()

.sex_bar <- function(cohort_nm, tag, show_legend = FALSE) {
  d <- sex_long |> dplyr::filter(Cohort == cohort_nm)
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = Metric, y = Pct, fill = sex_f)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.65) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = sex_pal, name = "Sex") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1),
                       limits = c(0, 100),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
    labs(tag = tag, x = NULL, y = "Proportion") +
    theme_cap() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
          plot.tag    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13))
  if (show_legend) p + theme(legend.position = "right")
  else             p + theme(legend.position = "none")
}

pSE <- .sex_bar("DM (primary)",      "E")
pSF <- .sex_bar("ASCVD (secondary)", "F", show_legend = TRUE)

fig7 <- (pSA | pSB) / (pSC | pSD) / (pSE | pSF) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 0.9))
fig7
ggsave("figures/fig7.tiff", fig7, width = 11, height = 11 * 1.1, dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
```

```{r rt_setup, include=FALSE}
.mask_n <- function(x) dplyr::if_else(x < 10L, 10L, x)
.mask_all_n <- function(df) dplyr::mutate(df, dplyr::across(
  dplyr::matches("^N$|^N_|^N "), .mask_n))
```

### RT1. Figure 1 panels A–B — Cardiovascular risk score distributions
```{r rt1_risk, echo=FALSE}
rt1 <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dm_scored |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(qrisk10y)) |>
    dplyr::summarise(Cohort = "DM (primary)", Metric = "QRISK2 10y (%)",
      N = dplyr::n(), Mean = round(mean(qrisk10y), 1), SD = round(sd(qrisk10y), 1),
      Median = round(median(qrisk10y), 1),
      Q1 = round(quantile(qrisk10y, 0.25), 1), Q3 = round(quantile(qrisk10y, 0.75), 1)),
  ascvd_scored |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(react5y)) |>
    dplyr::summarise(Cohort = "ASCVD (secondary)", Metric = "REACT 5y (%)",
      N = dplyr::n(), Mean = round(mean(react5y), 1), SD = round(sd(react5y), 1),
      Median = round(median(react5y), 1),
      Q1 = round(quantile(react5y, 0.25), 1), Q3 = round(quantile(react5y, 0.75), 1))
) |> .mask_all_n()
kbl(rt1) |>
```

### RT2. Figure 1 panels C–D — LDL-C and SBP distributions
```{r rt2_biomarkers, echo=FALSE}
.rt_summ <- function(df, cohort, metric, col) {
  df |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[col]])) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      N      = dplyr::n(),
      Mean   = round(mean(.data[[col]]), 2),
      SD     = round(sd(.data[[col]]), 2),
      Median = round(median(.data[[col]]), 2),
      Q1     = round(quantile(.data[[col]], 0.25), 2),
      Q3     = round(quantile(.data[[col]], 0.75), 2)
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Cohort = cohort, Metric = metric, .before = 1)
}
rt2 <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  .rt_summ(dm_scored,    "DM (primary)",      "LDL-C (mmol/L)", "ldl"),
  .rt_summ(ascvd_scored, "ASCVD (secondary)", "LDL-C (mmol/L)", "ldl"),
  .rt_summ(dm_scored,    "DM (primary)",      "SBP (mmHg)",     "sbp"),
  .rt_summ(ascvd_scored, "ASCVD (secondary)", "SBP (mmHg)",     "sbp")
) |> .mask_all_n()
kbl(rt2) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```
